title: LocationAssignedNumber
description: Details of a assigned phone number/extension in the user's location.

phoneNumber.description: The phone number in E.164 format.

state.description:
* `ACTIVE` - Phone number is in the active state.
 * `INACTIVE` - Phone number is in the inactive state.

phoneNumberType.description:
* `PRIMARY` - A direct phone number.
* `ALTERNATE` - An alternate phone number.
* `FAX` - A FAX number.

tollFreeNumber.description: Indicate if the number is toll free.

firstName.description: First name of the phone number/extension owner. This field is present only for type `PEOPLE` and `VIRTUAL_LINE`.

lastName.description: Last name of the phone number/extension owner. This field is present only for type `PEOPLE` and `VIRTUAL_LINE`.

displayName.description: Display Name of the phone number/extension owner.
